items.t: How to check a memecoin before buying: 6 checks in 5 minutes
items.x: Before you buy a memecoin, check its contract, liquidity, holders, top-10 share, age and the Binance security audit. A plain step-by-step checklist.

items.t: What is diversification? Why not to put everything in one coin or stock
items.x: Diversification means spreading your money so one bad coin or company can't wipe you out. What it is, how to do it simply and the mistakes to avoid.

items.t: How to connect Binance Wallet to a DEX and move coins back: step by step
items.x: Connect Binance Wallet to a DEX site safely, send coins back to your Binance account on the right network and remove old approvals — in plain steps.

items.t: What is investment risk? How much you can lose, in plain words
items.x: Prices can fall 50–80% and stay down for years. What risk means, how much you can really lose and why you invest only money you can afford to lose.

items.t: How to create a Binance Wallet and buy a memecoin: step by step
items.x: Create Binance Wallet in the Binance app, back it up, move coins in from your Binance account, find a token by contract and swap — with the safety checks.

items.t: Buying a little every month (DCA): how to start, step by step
items.x: What DCA (buying a fixed amount every week or month) is, why it suits beginners, its limits, and how to set it up in 5 simple steps.

items.t: What's happening with IREN (IREN)? Shares rebound 29% from a 52-week low
items.x: IREN jumped about 29% on Monday, a day after hitting a 52-week low, as AI cloud stocks rallied on Huang's return to Nvidia. Bitcoin rose only about 2%.

items.t: What's happening with Micron (MU)? Shares jump 19% as Huang returns to Nvidia
items.x: Micron rose about 19–20% on Monday after Nvidia brought back Jensen Huang, recovering most of last week's 23.6% slide. What moved it and what it means.

items.t: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; shares jump 32% and Nasdaq gains 7%
items.x: Nvidia's board unanimously brought Jensen Huang back as CEO on Monday. The stock rose about 32% and the Nasdaq about 7% — one of its best days in years.

items.t: Bitcoin ETFs lose $1.79 billion in a week, a fourth straight week of outflows
items.x: US spot bitcoin ETFs saw $1.79 billion of net outflows last week, the third-largest on record, led by BlackRock's IBIT. November's total is $4.14 billion so far.

items.t: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler for $43.9 billion in stock, a 34% premium
items.x: CrowdStrike agreed to buy Zscaler in an all-stock deal worth $43.9 billion, about $260 a share. One of the largest cybersecurity deals ever, explained simply.

items.t: Nvidia rebounds 9% premarket after Trump urges its board to rehire Jensen Huang
items.x: Nvidia rose about 9% before the bell on Monday after Friday's 14% crash, as Trump called on the board to bring back Jensen Huang. What changed and what did not.

items.t: UK bans crypto exchanges from market making on their own platforms from 2027
items.x: From October 25, 2027, UK-regulated crypto exchanges may not trade their own money on their own order books. What the FCA rule says and what it means for users.

items.t: US futures bounce 3% as Asia scrambles to stop the AI stock rout
items.x: Nasdaq 100 futures rose nearly 3% early Monday while Korea's KOSPI hit a 10-month low and Seoul, Taipei and Beijing readied support for markets. What happened.

items.t: Fusionist ACE bridge exploit: $2M mint attack, then traders drain $3.7M
items.x: An attacker minted unbacked ACE on BNB Chain and sold it for about $2M; traders then emptied the bridge of 53.7M real ACE worth about $3.7M. What happened.

items.t: Market wrap Nov 22: Bitcoin holds $60K as S&P 500 futures jump 2.1%
items.x: A calm Sunday after a brutal week. Bitcoin +1.2% to about $60,860, Ether +2%, and US stock futures rebounded 2.1% in the evening. What moved and why.

items.t: Nvidia fell 23% in a week, Bittensor 1%: AI tokens vs AI stocks
items.x: In the week Nvidia lost 23% and Micron 24%, Bittensor slipped only 1.4% and Render 2.9%. Why AI tokens held up, and why that is not the same as being safe.

items.t: Biggest crypto exchanges by volume: Binance had 39% of 2025 trading
items.x: The biggest crypto exchanges by trading volume — Binance, Bybit, MEXC, Gate, OKX, Coinbase — with reserves, trust scores and why biggest isn't safest.

items.t: Top 10 companies in the UK: $10 a day in each made +76% in 5 years
items.x: The largest UK companies by market cap — HSBC, AstraZeneca, Shell and 7 more — and what $10 a day in each returned over 5 years: +76%, ahead of the S&P 500.

items.t: What are memecoins, and why do almost all new ones die?
items.x: Memecoins are crypto tokens built on jokes and hype. CoinGecko counted 11.6 million dead tokens in 2025 alone — here is why, in plain words.

items.t: What is investing? Saving vs investing in plain words
items.x: What investing means, how it differs from saving, why inflation slowly eats cash, and the first 5 steps a beginner can take with small amounts.

items.t: AI stocks face a short Thanksgiving week after the Nasdaq's 5% weekly drop
items.x: After Nvidia's 14% slide and a 5.3% weekly Nasdaq drop, a holiday-shortened week brings Workday, Autodesk and the Fed's favourite inflation gauge.

items.t: Cyber bridge exploit: 5.2 million CYBER minted, Upbit and Bithumb freeze transfers
items.x: An attacker minted 5.21 million CYBER on Solana, moved them out of Cyber's Ethereum bridge and sold them for about $968,000 in ETH. Upbit and Bithumb froze transfers.

items.t: Saylor hints at another Strategy bitcoin buy with 850,849 BTC about 20% under water
items.x: Michael Saylor posted his purchase tracker on Sunday, hinting at a new buy. Strategy holds 850,849 BTC at an average $75,452 — well above today's price.

items.t: Chainflip hack grows to $12 million, including BTC; 10% bounty offered to the attacker
items.x: Chainflip now puts the November 21 theft at about $12 million, including 122.9 BTC, and offers the attacker 10% to return the rest by November 23, 18:38 UTC.

items.t: What's happening with DGrid AI (DGAI)? Up about 25% in a day after a buyback plan
items.x: DGrid AI's DGAI token rose about 25% in 24 hours, one of the top gainers in the top 200, two days after the project announced a buyback-and-burn program.

items.t: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17,000 on Kraken's Canadian-dollar market; trades stand
items.x: Kraken's BTC/CAD pair printed C$24,250 (about $16,900) on November 21, 71% below the dollar price. No hack, says Kraken, and executed trades will stand.

items.t: Coinbase plans its own prediction markets in 2027 after a $200 million run rate
items.x: Coinbase wants its own US prediction market contracts in the first half of 2027, not only Kalshi's. What was reported and what it means for COIN holders.

items.t: What's happening with Pieverse (PIEVERSE)? Price doubles in a week to a new record
items.x: PIEVERSE hit a record near $3.75–4.20 on November 22, up 80–110% in seven days as bitcoin bounced. What drove it and what it means for regular buyers.

items.t: Wrapped Monero token XMR1 crashes 99.8% on Hyperliquid after a $13.5 million dump
items.x: A compromised deployer key let an attacker sell XMR1 for about $13.5 million, sending it from $500 to $1 in 30 minutes. Native Monero (XMR) was not affected.

items.t: What's happening with MARA (MARA)? Bitcoin miners lose 16–19% in one day
items.x: MARA fell 18.6% on Friday, with IREN, Hut 8, CleanSpark and Cipher down 16–18%, as bitcoin broke below $60,000 and AI stocks sold off. What we know.

items.t: TRUMP memecoin holders dine with Trump today, with the coin down 99% from its peak
items.x: The top 185 TRUMP holders get a dinner with Donald Trump on November 22. The token rose about 9% on the news but is still about 99% below its January 2025 high.

items.t: What's happening with Venice Token (VVV)? Up about 24% in a day, top gainer in the top 200
items.x: VVV, the token of the private AI platform Venice, rose about 24% to near $25 on new exchange listings, lower emissions and a market rebound. What we know.

items.t: Market wrap Nov 21: Bitcoin bounces 9% from $55,130 back to $60K
items.x: Bitcoin hit its lowest level since September 2024 on Saturday, then climbed back above $60,000. Ether +3.4%, fear still at 12/100. What moved and why.

items.t: Crypto staking providers compared: they keep 10% to 35% of your rewards
items.x: Crypto staking providers compared – Kraken, Coinbase, Lido, Binance and solo staking: fees of 10–35% of rewards, lock-ups, withdrawal times and risks.

items.t: November 2026: S&P 500 −8.7%, gold −9.8%, Bitcoin −22% — nowhere to hide
items.x: With a week left, November is the S&P 500's 10th-worst month since 2000 and gold's 6th-worst. What history says and what $10 a day did through it.

items.t: Bitcoin bounces back above $60,000 after hitting $55,130, its lowest since 2024
items.x: Bitcoin climbed about 9% on November 21 from a low of $55,130 to reclaim $60,000, after $1.8 billion of leveraged bets were wiped out in a day.

items.t: Chainflip hacked for $4.86 million; FLIP token drops 34% as swaps are paused
items.x: An attacker drained about $4.86 million from Chainflip's Ethereum vault on November 21, likely with a compromised signing key. FLIP fell 34% and swaps stopped.

items.t: SEC's Atkins lays out plan for tokenized stocks and longer US trading hours
items.x: SEC Chairman Paul Atkins and markets director Jamie Selway explained how tokenized US shares and near-24-hour trading could work, and what still blocks them.

items.t: Bitcoin Core fixes AI-found bug that could stall nodes; update to 30.5 or 31.3
items.x: Bitcoin Core 30.5 and 31.3 patch a medium-severity bug, found by an AI scanner at Block's Spiral, that let one peer freeze a node for over 10 seconds at a time.
